Question: Which product category has the highest average item price? Use the English name.
text:
```sql
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english
FROM (
    SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.price) AS avg_price
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
) AS sub
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct
  ON sub.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
ORDER BY sub.avg_price DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
This query computes the average price of items for each product category, then returns the English name of the category with the highest average price.
reasoning:
